title: find_immutable_patch_key slash-path detection is correct and non-obvious
description: email.rs:600-611: the check 'key.as_bytes().get(field.len()) == Some(&b'/')' correctly distinguishes 'messageId' (exact match), 'messageId/0' (sub-path, blocked) and 'messageIdExtra' (prefix but not a path, allowed). A contributor simplifying this to key.starts_with(field) would break the third case. The byte-index check is the right implementation.
